script_text: Cancer, the Moon is shaking your foundations this week and absolutely nothing will ever stay hidden from you. Monday through Wednesday, Jupiter in your 1st House conjuncts your Sun while Mars pushes your 10th House career forward. You feel unstoppable, but Neptune square your Sun creates early friction. Tuesday brings a tempting financial offer; do not sign yet. By Thursday, Venus sextiles your Moon in your 8th House, unlocking shared funds or a deepening romance that changes everything. The weekend brings a golden trine from your Water ruler to the Midheaven, signaling a promotion or public recognition you truly deserve this year. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles your sensitive Cancer Moon. Friday is your caution day due to Mercury's friction with daily work. Trust your intuition today; the cosmic stars back your next big move completely and without delay. Follow for daily updates.
